title: TotemSwapper
description: Automatically moves a Totem of Undying to your offhand with a configurable keybind. Lightweight, client-side, and easy to use.
body:
Totem Swapper

Instantly equips a Totem of Undying into your offhand with a single key press.

Features
⚡ One-key totem swapping
🎮 Client-side Fabric mod
🔍 Automatically finds the first Totem of Undying in your inventory
🖐 Swaps the totem directly into your offhand
💬 Toggle the mod on or off at any time
🪶 Lightweight with no unnecessary features
How it works
Press the assigned key (default: R) to enable or disable Totem Swapper.
When enabled, the mod automatically looks for a Totem of Undying in your inventory.
If your offhand doesn't already contain a totem, it opens your inventory for a split second, moves the first available totem into your offhand, and closes the inventory automatically.

The mod searches both your hotbar and main inventory for the first available totem.

Default Keybind
R — Toggle Totem Swapper on/off

The keybind can be changed in Minecraft's Controls menu.

Requirements
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Minecraft (compatible version matching the release)
Notes
This is a client-side mod.
No server installation is required.
Works on servers as long as they allow normal inventory interactions.
The mod only swaps a totem if your offhand does not already contain one.
If you have any issues, report them on the discord!
